[1] faq.md > Do you ship fuel to Canada?
### Do you ship outside the United States?

We ship to all 50 states and to Canada. Shipping to Canada is a flat $19.95 and takes 5 to 10
business days; duties and taxes are paid by the recipient on delivery. We do not ship to any
other country.

### Do you ship fuel to Canada?

No. Clearburn white gas, lamp oil and kerosene ship by ground only inside the United States, and
never to Canada, Alaska, Hawaii or a PO box. If a Canadian order contains fuel, we remove the fuel
and refund it before the rest of the order ships.

### Can I pick my order up instead?

Yes, at the Frederick showroom only. Choose curbside pickup at checkout and your order is ready
within 2 hours during store hours, Monday through Saturday 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Pickup is free.
The Annapolis showroom does not offer curbside pickup.

### Signature on delivery

Orders over $400 ship with a signature required. The threshold is applied to the merchandise
subtotal. Customers who cannot be present may redirect the package to a UPS Access Point through
the carrier's tracking page. The warehouse does not waive the signature requirement on request.

## Fuel and hazardous materials

Clearburn White Gas (LS-FUEL1), Clearburn Lamp Oil (LS-OIL1) and kerosene are limited-quantity
hazardous materials, shipped as ORM-D. The rules are:

- Fuel ships by ground only. It cannot go expedited or overnight; an order containing fuel is
  downgraded to standard shipping and the customer is told at checkout.
- Fuel does not ship to PO boxes.
- Fuel does not ship to Alaska, Hawaii or Canada.
- No more than 8 quarts of fuel ship in one package. Larger fuel orders are split.
- Fuel ships only in its original sealed container, in the warehouse's partitioned fuel cartons.

An order that mixes fuel with other items ships as two packages when the non-fuel items are
eligible for a faster service the customer has paid for. Otherwise the whole order ships ground.

Fuel-burning lanterns that have never had fuel in them are ordinary goods and ship by any
service. A fueled lantern, for example one coming back for repair, must be fully drained and
aired out before it ships; the Repair Center's instructions cover this.

[4] fuel-safety.md > Shipping fuel
## Disposal

Never pour fuel down a drain, onto the ground, or into household trash. White gas and kerosene
are household hazardous waste. Every Maryland county runs household hazardous waste collection,
either at a permanent site or on scheduled days; Frederick County's site is at the Public Safety
Training Facility and takes fuel on the first and third Saturdays of the month. Take the fuel
in its original container.

Old lamp oil can be burned off in the lamp it was bought for if it is still clear. Oil that has
gone cloudy or has a sediment goes to hazardous waste collection with the rest. Empty cans and
bottles go in household recycling once they are dry and the cap is off.

If you bought the fuel from us and want it gone, bring the can to either showroom and we will
dispose of it; we do not charge for this.

## Shipping fuel

Fuel ships by ground only, as a limited-quantity hazardous material (ORM-D), from the
Hagerstown warehouse. It cannot ship expedited or overnight, cannot be delivered to a PO box,
and cannot be shipped to Alaska, Hawaii or Canada. An order that contains fuel ships as a whole
by ground; if you want the rest of your order faster, place the fuel on its own order. Fuel is
final sale once opened and cannot be returned by mail at all, opened or not; an unopened can
bought in error can be returned to either showroom for a refund.

Never ship a lantern with fuel in it, including for a warranty or repair return. Drain it,
let it air for a day, and pack it with the cap off. A lantern that arrives at Dock B with fuel
in it is drained before it is looked at, and we charge nothing for that, but the carrier can
refuse the box and the law is on their side.

## When to stop using a lantern

Stop using any fuel lantern and bring it to a showroom or contact us if the tank leaks or
weeps at a seam, if the Northstar will not hold pressure after the pump cup has been oiled, if
the flame burns yellow and sooty on the right fuel, if a wick lantern's flame keeps climbing
after the wick is turned down, or if you smell fuel when the lantern is not lit. Tanks are not
repaired; a lantern with a leaking tank is replaced under warranty if it is within the period,
and otherwise retired.

[5] employee-handbook.md > Fuel safety in the showrooms
## Fuel safety in the showrooms

Both showrooms stock fuel for sale, but fuel on a showroom floor is limited to 2 quarts of display
stock in total, across Clearburn white gas, Clearburn lamp oil and kerosene. Everything else stays
in the locked fuel cabinet in the back room, which holds no more than the quantity on the
cabinet's placard. There is no fuel room at either showroom; the only fuel room in the company is
at the Hagerstown warehouse, and bulk fuel is never stored at a showroom overnight outside the
cabinet.

Demonstration lanterns on the floor run on Clearburn white gas or lamp oil as the product
requires. Never fuel a demonstration lantern on the sales floor; take it to the back-room fueling
tray. Never fuel a hot lantern; let it cool for 10 minutes. Spills are cleaned at once with the
absorbent pads in the cabinet, and the pads go in the red bin, not the trash.

Fire extinguishers at every location are checked monthly by Denise Okafor, the Warehouse
Manager, or by a person she designates in writing, and the check is recorded on the tag. If a tag
is more than 31 days old, tell your manager that day. Every employee is shown how to use an
extinguisher in their first week. A showroom never has fewer than two working extinguishers on
the floor.

Fuel sold in a showroom goes out in the customer's hands; we never ship fuel from a showroom.
Fuel ordered online ships by ground only from Hagerstown, never to a PO box and never to Alaska,
Hawaii or Canada. If a customer asks you to make an exception, the answer is no.

## Customer service standards

Every email to help@lanternsupply.example is answered within 1 business day, and most are answered
the same day. A phone caller should wait less than 3 minutes; if the queue is longer than that,
the shift lead pulls in a second person. Chat on the online store follows the same 3-minute
standard during support hours and shows the next-day email promise outside them.

Know the policies before you quote them. The return window is 40 days from the delivery date,
the standard warranty is 2 years, and the full details are in the returns policy, the shipping
policy, the warranty policy and the customer service playbook. Any refund, credit or goodwill over
$500 needs approval from Tomas Reyes, Head of Customer Service, and anything over $2,000 needs
Priya Whitcomb-Nair's. Do not promise what you cannot approve.
